AdvanceMode.description: Who moves the quiz forward between questions.

oneOf.description: The host clicks to continue.
The quiz continues by itself after a short pause.

image.description: Name of an uploaded picture, if any.

text.description: May be empty when the answer has a picture.

Bonus.description:
A bonus question: teams type its answer together with the main answer, and the judge can
amend the verdict as for typed answers. A right answer adds a share of the question's points.

accepted.description: Accepted spellings, matched like a typed answer.

percent.description: What a right answer adds, in percent of the points the main answer can earn.

text.description: The bonus question, e.g. "Who sings it?".

ImageReveal.description: How a question's picture is revealed on the big screen while the clock runs.

oneOf.description: Shown as is.
Starts as a close-up of its centre and zooms out to the whole picture.
Starts covered by tiles that drop away one by one.

LibraryLink.description: Ties a quiz question to a library question (see `sync`).

synced.description:
The `fingerprint` of the question when the quiz and the library last
had the same one: which of the two changed since.

MultiScoring.description: How questions with several correct answers are scored.

oneOf.description: Points only for selecting exactly the correct set.
Credit proportional to correct picks minus wrong picks.

NetworkSlide.description:
The Wi-Fi network teams join before the game, shown on a first slide with a QR code that
connects phones to it. The name and password are kept while the slide is off.

enabled.description: Whether the game opens on the slide, before the join code.

NumberRange.description: The numbers a closest-number question accepts, both ends included.

NumberScoring.description: How a number question is scored.

oneOf.description: The closest guesses win a set amount, however long they took; the others nothing.

Full points up to `full_within` from the correct number, nothing beyond `none_beyond`,
and a share falling evenly in between.

Full points up to `margin` from the correct number (0: only the exact number), nothing
beyond.

Pair.description: Two items that go together in a `Pairs` question.

PairItem.description: One side of a `Pairs` pair: a text, a picture, or both.

image.description: Name of an uploaded picture, if any.

accepted.description: Accepted spellings, matched like a typed answer.

image.description: A picture just for this part (a poster, a face…).

PhoneDisplay.description: What team leaders see on their phones while answering.

oneOf.description: Only coloured shapes; the question is read on the big screen.
The question and answer texts as well.

PinTolerance.description:
How close a pin must be: within the first distance it earns full points, beyond the second
none, and in between a share falling evenly. Distances are in picture widths.

Point.description: A spot on a picture, as fractions of its width (`x`) and height (`y`) from the top left.

PointsMode.description: What a correct answer is worth.

oneOf.description: Faster answers earn more: from 1000 points when instant down to 500 at the buzzer.
Every correct answer earns 1000 points, however long it took.

Question.description: A single question, or a slide between questions.

answers.description: The options of a multiple-choice question (kept, but unused, for other kinds).

audio.description: Name of an uploaded soundtrack, if any. The host starts it, and the clock with it.

bonus.description: A typed bonus question, answered together with this one.

category.description:
What the question is about, e.g. "Geography", shown on the big screen. Library questions
keep the category they come from.

explanation.description: Shown on the big screen only once the answer is revealed: an explanation, a fun fact…

explanation_audio.description: Name of an uploaded soundtrack the big screen plays once the answer is revealed.

explanation_image.description: Name of an uploaded picture or video shown with the `explanation`.

image.description: Name of an uploaded picture, if any.

image_hold_secs.description:
With a gradual reveal, how many seconds before the buzzer the picture is fully shown: the
reveal takes the rest of the time.

image_reveal.description:
How the picture is revealed while the clock runs. Reads the former `blur_image` flag
as `Zoom`.

kind.description: How teams answer. Older quizzes without it are multiple choice.

library.description: The library question this one was added from or saved as, to keep the two in step.

multiplier.description: The question is worth this many times a usual one (`None` counts once).

passage.description: Text shown with the question, line breaks kept: lyrics, a quote, a riddle…

text.description: The question, or the body text of a slide.

time_limit_secs.description: Overrides the quiz-wide time limit when set.

topic.description: The subject within the category, e.g. "Capitals", shown with it.

oneOf.description: Pick one or more of the listed answers.
Type a short answer, right when it matches an accepted one (the judge may amend).
Enter a number; by default the closest guess wins.

range.description: The numbers teams can give, if limited: phones then also show a slider.

oneOf.description: Put items in order; `items` are listed in the right order and shown shuffled.
Is the statement true or false? Played like a two-answer multiple choice.

Several typed answers at once (title and artist, five posters…), each judged on its own;
the question's points are split evenly between the parts.
Drop a pin on the question's picture (a map, a floor plan…); closer pins earn more.

answer.description: The right spot, as fractions of the picture's width and height.

aspect.description: The picture's height divided by its width, so distances are measured evenly.

oneOf.description:
Match each item on the left with its partner on the right; `pairs` are listed matched,
and the right column is shown shuffled. Each pair rightly matched earns its share.

Not a question: a title, text and/or picture shown on the big screen, with nothing to
answer.

results.description:
A results slide: when answers are revealed at the end, it walks through the answers
to the questions since the previous results slide, then shows the standings (an
intermission, say). Its title heads the standings; it has no text or picture.

QuizSettings.description: Per-quiz options chosen by the admin.

default_time_limit_secs.description: Time limit for questions that do not set their own.

joker.description: Each team may double one question's points.

network.description: A first slide telling the room how to get on the Wi-Fi.

RevealMode.description: When correct answers and scores are shown.

oneOf.description: After every question, with the current standings.
Only once all questions have been played, keeping the suspense.

description: A quiz exported by Quaesito, file format 3.

$schema.description: Where this format is described, for editors that check JSON files.

created.description: When the quiz was created, in seconds since 1970; set when it is first saved.

format.description: Version of the file format. Files without it are version 1.

questions.description: Questions and slides, in playing order.

title: Quaesito quiz
